scope: TOL-004 candidate-bound authorization and execution audit lifecycle on disposable PostgreSQL and MinIO.

observations.audit: The durable lifecycle validates correlated append-only authorization, grant-consumption, execution-intent, terminal-outcome, and grant-terminal audit facts.
observations.limitations: This is state/audit integration, not a public browser, protected sandbox, Firecracker, Linux/KVM, or Stack claim.

redaction: No secret values, IDs, descriptors, inputs, artifact bodies, database credentials, or endpoints are retained.
